name: Application workspace and personalized answer preparation
description: Populate Discover previews and application drafts with sourced employer facts and personalized editable answer starters; report incomplete work explicitly.
whenToUse: Before preparing application answers, populating Discover previews, resolving human-input questions, or explaining approval and submission.
instructions:
# Application workspace

## Discovery to published workspace

Start from the current owned profile and sources. The daily scan must not inherit a single proof employer as its complete search universe. Use Simplify Summer 2027 and New Grad as aggregate lead inputs, plus suitable copied Career Ops providers. Aggregate dates describe list recency, not employer publication dates. Check employer availability and canonical URLs.

For an official Simplify source already in the owned run, call read_search_source_leads {runId,sourceId,offset,limit} to get bounded lead pages and source-list recency. Follow nextOffset or report truncated coverage.

When the personal-agent runtime has web search, run the configured queries there and pass resulting canonical employer URLs to submit_search_leads {runId,sourceId,leads:[{url}],eventKey} through the Node MCP endpoint. The tool performs bounded supported ATS verification/full-description parsing and returns saved observations plus explicit per-lead failures. It does not execute a search engine or invent results when runtime search is unavailable. A sourceId must belong to the owned active run. Reuse identical requests after transport uncertainty. Unsupported sources require agent verification through the existing observed-discovery tools with source evidence; never label them server-verified.

Call screen_search_discoveries {runId,listingIds,eventKey} for bounded current-profile screening. Read returned requirement checks, exclusions and unresolved evidence, including the profile version used. Changing Full-time/Internship or Hybrid/Remote preferences requires rescreening; saving a preference does not itself wake Muse. Raw observations stay separate from filtered candidates, personal analysis and published cards. Unknown authorization, availability or office agreement is not a factual Yes. Do not hide credible internship opportunities solely because a graduation-delay decision is unresolved.

Read full source descriptions for the shortlisted roles, compare each against résumé evidence, explain technical upside and a material gap, generate all four private score/reasoning dimensions, and publish_batch. Keep unsupported scores null. Prepare source-grounded editable application answers through prepare_draft; current secure approval limitations still apply. Confirm the published card count, full modal, saved answers and four dimensions through owned read-back. Report partial source coverage rather than calling a bounded sample an exhaustive daily scan.

The personal agent performs research and writing; Lookout displays its saved work. Read context versions and current personal context, search profile, owned resume metadata/files as permitted, saved answers and relevant owned artifacts. Use user-provided writing preferences/examples when available. Do not assume Muse memory is accessible through an API. If facts, resume or writing preferences cannot be read, report which input is unavailable; do not invent a candidate or voice.

Inspect the canonical live employer posting and entire accessible form, including required/optional fields, selectable options, file requirements and field identities. Preserve field types and required flags. Distinguish source extraction failure from a field the employer does not disclose. Do not turn every blank optional field into a blocker. Sensitive voluntary questions remain optional and never get inferred answers. Hidden transport fields are not questions for the user.

Use verified applicant facts for factual autofill. Reuse saved answers only under their current question/company/permission policy. For written questions, draft a relevant response starter from applicant evidence and the current writing preferences, leaving it editable. Missing preferences permit neutral writing clearly labeled as a fallback; missing facts must be disclosed rather than made up. Do not invent agreement to relocation, office attendance, salary, authorization or other personal choices. Record why genuinely unresolved decisions need human input. Optional omissions are not required answers.

Save through prepare_draft with the exact current revision. Preserve existing human edits, statuses and approved versions; reread after a conflict. Read back through read_workspace/read_application_record and compare the persisted answers and field metadata. A successful search run is not proof that Discover cards, analyses or drafts are complete. Publish the selected records through publish_batch with a fresh idempotency key, detailed role-specific whyItFits/materialGap and all four agent-generated score/reasoning dimensions. Null scores are explicit unknowns when applicant evidence is missing. Explain technical scope, upside, actual requirements, candidate evidence and one material gap; do not inflate scores or repeat generic fit language.

A recommendation may include jobFacts {sourceUrl,checkedAt,workSetting,sponsorship}, a bounded source observation attached to that immutable private batch. Use the canonical employer source, explicitly label undisclosed sponsorship, and preserve the shared catalog record. This observation does not grant submission authority or rewrite historical batches.

Current UI limits: Discover answer-preview edits are temporary and do not persist. Direct the user to Applications to save edits and approve the exact version through authenticated website review. prepare_draft never creates human approval. Per-answer review checkboxes, durable Discover editing and authenticated approval through Muse are intended behavior, NOT implemented capabilities. An agent relaying "the user approved" is not a backend approval receipt. Explain this gap when the user requests chat authorization; use the existing human-action handoff. Never claim an application was submitted from saving/reviewing a draft. Recheck current authorization, exact version and supported runner capability before submission; require observed employer confirmation, and pause on uncertain outcomes.

## Resume after human review on the next work cycle

Only perform this sequence during an already authorized application task or an explicit user request to continue applications. Connecting/reconnecting, reading the inbox, and resolving an action never wake Muse or authorize unrelated work. A search-only cycle does not authorize submission.

1. Refresh context versions and changed developer/personal context. Load this guide and refresh tool discovery when the developer version changes.
2. Call read_action_inbox with state all, following nextOffset for relevant pending and resolved handoffs. Approval removes a pending handoff, so pending-only reads miss work ready to revisit. Treat history as a reference to the application, not execution permission.
3. Read current owned applications through read_workspace and read_application_record. Preserve human edits. Do not call prepare_draft merely to resume an unchanged approved version. Skip submitted/final records and unresolved started/uncertain attempts.
4. If current policy requires human approval, call read_approval with applicationId. Require approval for the exact current revision. Null means no current approval; changed answers, resume or form require review again. Routine applications can qualify under current saved backend policy without a fabricated approval.
5. If an existing assigned agent task requires claiming, claim_agent_task before work and report_agent_task_result afterward under its lease contract. An inbox record is not an agent task or a new schedule.
6. Discover the supported submit_application runner tool. It obtains fresh server authorization, validates current form/resume/draft, and handles its existing claim/one-click/receipt flow. Missing tool, scope, authorization or source context is a blocker; do not substitute direct browser clicks or a general backend job.
7. A verified-not-submitted human resolution allows considering a fresh attempt after authorization. Use a new stable attemptId for that new attempt. Never rerun an old uncertain execution. A user_reported_submitted resolution means reported progress with retry blocked, not an observed employer receipt. Read saved outcomes and report only what actually happened.

Inbox resolution is persisted for the next authorized pull cycle; it does not trigger an immediate Muse run. If this inbox migration/tool is unavailable in the connected backend, report that deployment gap instead of claiming automatic pickup.

## Bounded Node submission batches

When the configured Node MCP advertises submit_application_batch, read current revisions and call it with eventKey and applications [{applicationId,expectedRevision}] (1–10 unique references). Each child runs the existing guarded submit_application flow sequentially; batches do not approve anything. Read read_application_batches after an interrupted response. Reissue the same eventKey and exact payload only to reconcile/resume that batch: active leases report busy, terminal results replay without execution, and expired leases retain stable per-application attempt IDs. A partial result reports independent outcomes, not all-or-nothing success. After authorized blocker repair or human review, use a new eventKey and current revision to request a fresh eligible attempt. A still-uncertain outcome cannot be repaired by an agent or automatically retried. The search cron does not execute these submissions. Missing Node tools/configuration or deployment remains explicit.

## Choose the profile-mapped resume

Bind the draft to its owned active searchProfileId. Preparation and automatic submission share the same selector: match active role assignments by normalized job-title phrase and job type, then use this profile’s fallback resume. Blank assignment employment inherits profile job types; blank assignment resume uses the profile fallback. Account-wide legacy rules/defaults are only for accounts without a bound/profile resume configuration. Do not substitute them when this profile is missing a file or fallback.

Read handoff.resumeSelection after prepare_draft. Conflicting files, invalid targets, unavailable/superseded files and unevaluated additional conditions/timelines require review. Automatic new selections pin the owned file/hash. Existing explicit draft choices stay unchanged; a choice differing from the current assignment needs exact human review. Before routine submission the backend rereads the canonical current profile and requires the pinned file to match. A mapping edit does not silently change an already prepared or approved file. Selection never creates approval or bypasses current policy.

Fail loudly: report the affected tool/page, safe HTTP/error code, missing field or context source, persistence state and concrete next repair. Finish search runs as partial when sources are inaccessible or truncated. Do not convert errors to empty successful results, silently substitute demo records, mark missing evidence as complete, or rerun blindly. Verify persisted data and rendered UI. Explicit source-unknown values are allowed; unresolved missing context and unavailable capabilities remain blockers with a truthful partial result. Never log secrets or private document contents.

## Automatic interview reporting

During authorized conversations or email checks, automatically save relevant interview/process updates and candidate reflections without a separate save confirmation. Read the owned application timeline first. Use record_application_milestone for process facts: source email retains message evidence; source user_reported contains a bounded note of what the candidate actually said and must never claim authenticated human or email verification. Leave uncertain dates null; ask only to resolve a material ambiguity such as which application or an unknown time. For corrections/rescheduling, supersedesId names the current owned milestone being replaced; preserve the original history and reread after a replacement conflict. Save reflections as simple private save_artifact notes (format markdown, purpose "Interview debrief [applicationId] Interview note", company and links [{applicationId}], sources [] unless there are actual dated public sources). List/read existing notes first; use a stable UUID and expectedVersion 0 for a new note, current version for edits, and reread after conflicts. Reuse the same UUID/content on uncertain retries, never create duplicate summaries of the same conversation. Separate candidate statements from agent interpretation in the body; never invent feedback, completion, dates or consent. Read back before reporting saved. Saving never posts to Circles, approves, supplies a submission receipt or completes practice. This runs only when Muse actually receives authorized conversation/source access; no background monitor or wake-up is implied.

expectedOutput.drafts: Persisted editable answer starters grounded in applicant evidence and source-form metadata.
expectedOutput.verification: Read-back confirmation and explicit partial failures; no invented approval or submission.
